model_rationale: One common available model for every B0 arm, including native-domain backend-adapted smoke; independent of A qwen3.8-max outcomes. Not QWEN_MAX_SILVER supervision.
selection: All 16 P1 participants, smallest block per participant, five original P1 candidates
source_policy: Original frozen source-anchor paragraphs; draft machine conditions identified as unconfirmed. No Silver audits or labels.
initialization: B1 fixed ranking followed by independent post-hoc explanation; shared byte-identical B1 output for every revision arm
tool_policy: Complete 42-day query and deterministic statistics and fixed source paragraphs; identical implementation and visibility for CRITIC and all ECR arms
matching_limit: Same maximum output allocation and one revision; actual input/output tokens, early stops, calls and costs separately reported. This is ceiling matching, not identical realized compute.
definition_provenance: New definitions authorized by user because no prior B0 branch/protocol exists. They are internal cumulative prompting ablations, not paper baselines or established new algorithms.
intervention: Reverse candidate presentation order for first four subject-sorted participants; execute every arm from newly shared B1 initialization. Invariance is behavioral, not clinical correctness.
prompt_tuning: v1 fixed-ranking interface, v2 null-array JSON-mode, and v3 overly conservative byte-as-context guard failures retained. v4 changes only the guard: <=120000 serialized UTF8 bytes, no truncation; actual token window enforced by provider. No S4 final recommendation used to tune other arms. Unchanged exact requests reuse their original cache.
context_guard: 120000 serialized UTF8 bytes for every arm; bytes used conservatively for monetary reservation, never presented as exact token counts. Provider context rejection remains a failure.
output_transport: record_b0 declarative function, common schemas; no output execution. For RARR parser compatibility, genuine model fields receive deterministic marker wrappers. No model reason or label is changed.
privacy: All record-level inputs, model outputs, feedback and tool trajectories stay in experiment_b0/local
